_comment: Poway-area food provider directory. Findhelp's 'food pantry in Poway' results (24) contain no providers located in Poway; they are county-wide (Chula Vista, Oceanside, Encinitas etc.). So this file combines (1) providers actually in/near Poway found via the orgs' sites, San Diego Food Bank calendars and City of Poway docs, and (2) the findhelp regional list, with schedules corrected from each org's own website. Events generated 2026-09-28 to 2026-12-31 from published recurring schedules.
_source: findhelp.org food-pantry--poway-ca (Sep 2026) + org websites/social + San Diego Food Bank 2026 Senior Food Program calendar + poway.org
_verify_before_running: Set _shellId. All lat/lng are null: geocode before seeding. Review _verifyNotes. _excluded lists dropped programs.
_excluded: City of Poway - Congregate Meal Program (Poway Senior Center): not free (paid tiers, reservation required)
Mesa View Baptist Church: only source is a March 2023 Food Bank roster; church site shows no food program
Penasquitos Lutheran Church (Community Food and Prayer site): only source dated 2017; referral-based
Society of St. Vincent de Paul - Diocesan Council of San Diego: no public pantry hours
Catholic Charities Diocese of San Diego: page shows temporarily closed notice
Mama's Kitchen: home delivery, medical referral only
Christ The King Lutheran Church: God's Bounty not mentioned on church site (unverified)
Jacobs and Cushman San Diego Food Bank: no single site; senior boxes assigned at enrollment (RB site included separately)
USO San Diego: appears discontinued; active duty only
Saint Rose of Lima Catholic Church: no schedule found

vendors.name: The Community Food Connection
vendors.tagline: Every Mon, Wed, Fri, 3 PM - 6 PM · Poway area
vendors.description: Free food program (Drive-thru grocery distribution (perishables and non-perishables)). Schedule: Drive-thru Food Distribution: Every Mon, Wed, Fri, 3 PM - 6 PM. Eligibility: Not stated on site; serves Poway, Ramona, Rancho Bernardo and surrounding communities. SDFB EFAP partner.. Call ahead to confirm - distributions often end early when supplies run out, and schedules change with holidays and weather.
vendors.address: 14047 Twin Peaks Road, Building C (behind Trinity Church), Poway, CA 92064
vendors.hours: Every Mon, Wed, Fri, 3 PM - 6 PM (Drive-thru Food Distribution)
vendors._verifyNotes: Schedule consistent across org homepage, The Church at Rancho Bernardo resource list, and SDFB EFAP roster (dated 2023-03-22). Schedule pattern uses 3 days (Mon/Wed/Fri), extending the requested pattern format. Phone conflict: org site and Church at RB list (858) 751-4613; City of Poway food-recovery doc (2025-07-30) lists (858) 487-4755, which is actually St. Michael's parish number, so treat as an error. No Instagram found. /get-food-1 and /contact pages blocked by robots.txt. A 2017 Community Food and Prayer page also listed 'The Connection Church' at this same address with a 4th-Thursday SDFB distribution for 92064 families; not confirmed current.
